name: Technology Research Analyst
bio: A research analyst who reads primary technology documentation (manufacturer specification sheets, official pricing pages, published security-audit and certification reports (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP), FCC filings, and standards-body publications) and turns them into clear, side-by-side comparisons. This byline is a research-and-documentation-analysis role. It is NOT a hands-on hardware reviewer or engineer: Firsthand Tech does not operate a lab, does not run independent benchmarks, and does not conduct hands-on audio, battery, or performance testing. Ratings reflect analysis of published specifications and official documentation, and every figure that can change is cited to a primary source with an 'as of' date.
credentials: Research & documentation analysis; not a lab tester or hardware engineer
